provider-not-found-exception.title: File system provider not found
provider-not-found-exception.short: Check that the URI scheme has an available provider
provider-not-found-exception.summary: ProviderNotFoundException is thrown when no installed FileSystemProvider supports the requested scheme.
provider-not-found-exception.why: FileSystems delegates URI handling to a provider for that scheme, so it cannot create the file system when no matching implementation is available.
provider-not-found-exception.tips: Use a supported scheme or verify that the required FileSystemProvider is available at runtime.
